name: clinpub
description: End-to-end clinical data analysis and publication pipeline. Core pipeline Phase 0-3: data cleaning, adaptive statistical analysis, IMRAD manuscript writing, plus standalone tools for manuscript improvement, cover letter generation, post-submission peer-review response, analysis modification, topic mining, and milestone gating.
descriptionZh: 端到端临床数据分析与发表管线。核心管线 Phase 0-3：数据清洗、自适应统计分析、IMRAD 论文写作；独立工具：稿件改进、投稿信生成、投稿后审稿意见回复、分析修改、选题挖掘、阶段里程碑。
